method: Decoded final MP4 independently into 11 contact sheets and 5 native-resolution stills, inspected visually by the assistant.

intro.findings: Opening fade, greeting, 16-symbol inventory, six A-F value cards, 1A/26 example, 16/1 weights and blank-place explanation are coherent.

transitions.findings: Six comparison bands keep the correct equation across the number cut. 3F uses its full place check and resumes directly at40/64 without a band flash.

place_check.findings: Equation3×16+15=63 and sign63 persist; weight16 then1; last pre-cut frame8935 retains3F, frame8936 shows40/64.

finale.findings: 7F/127 held; existing greeting pose and one-hand sign support show no clipping; final cream fade ends cleanly.

native_findings: Greeting/farewell anatomy, sign support, and seven/eight/E word highlights fit. No clipped descender, uneven word baseline or label overlap seen.
limitations: Visual inspection samples encoded frames; it is not continuous human playback or an audio listening review. Quantization to the next30fps frame can put a nominal +7.999s sample after the logical pause end.
